<article class="note-row" data-note="research-approach" data-topic="研究方法"><span class="note-number" aria-hidden="true">01</span><div class="note-copy"><div class="note-kicker"><span>研究方法</span><span>研究总览</span></div><h2><a href="research-approach.html">从数据到判断：我的研究方法</a></h2><p>将表示学习、可解释建模与可靠评测串起来：先定义问题，再讨论模型是否真的解决了问题。</p></div><span class="note-time">4 分钟<i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></span></article>
<article class="note-row" data-note="weibo-dynamics" data-topic="观点动力学"><span class="note-number" aria-hidden="true">02</span><div class="note-copy"><div class="note-kicker"><span>观点动力学</span><span>2026 · 期刊论文</span></div><h2><a href="weibo-dynamics.html">评论情绪之外：如何理解社区之间的相互依赖</a></h2><p>把评论文本变成社区状态，再用动力学模型理解情绪变化。关键在于明确观测对象与解释边界。</p></div><span class="note-time">3 分钟<i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></span></article>
<article class="note-row" data-note="code-dynamics" data-topic="代码智能"><span class="note-number" aria-hidden="true">03</span><div class="note-copy"><div class="note-kicker"><span>代码智能</span><span>2026 · 期刊论文</span></div><h2><a href="code-dynamics.html">代码不仅是文本，也是协作留下的轨迹</a></h2><p>代码嵌入不只服务检索。把它放回时间和协作关系中，可以研究软件演化中的趋同与分化。</p></div><span class="note-time">3 分钟<i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></span></article>
<article class="note-row" data-note="code-evaluation" data-topic="代码智能"><span class="note-number" aria-hidden="true">04</span><div class="note-copy"><div class="note-kicker"><span>代码智能</span><span>2026 · 研讨会论文</span></div><h2><a href="code-evaluation.html">评测代码：看起来合理，不等于真的正确</a></h2><p>为什么大模型打分与代码对数概率会给出不同判断？从已发表实验理解评测信号的适用范围。</p></div><span class="note-time">3 分钟<i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></span></article>
<article class="note-row" data-note="efficient-models" data-topic="高效机器学习"><span class="note-number" aria-hidden="true">05</span><div class="note-copy"><div class="note-kicker"><span>高效机器学习</span><span>2025 · 期刊论文</span></div><h2><a href="efficient-models.html">轻量化不是单纯把模型变小</a></h2><p>从轴承故障诊断出发，理解知识蒸馏、低秩适配与质量约束之间的关系。</p></div><span class="note-time">3 分钟<i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></span></article>
<article class="note-row" data-note="multimodal-robustness" data-topic="多模态与时序"><span class="note-number" aria-hidden="true">06</span><div class="note-copy"><div class="note-kicker"><span>多模态与时序</span><span>2023 · 期刊论文</span></div><h2><a href="multimodal-robustness.html">多一个模态，什么时候才真正有用</a></h2><p>从视听语音识别的复现与比较出发，讨论信息互补、噪声条件和跨数据集泛化。</p></div><span class="note-time">3 分钟<i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></span></article>
<article class="note-row" data-note="anomaly-detection" data-topic="多模态与时序"><span class="note-number" aria-hidden="true">07</span><div class="note-copy"><div class="note-kicker"><span>多模态与时序</span><span>2022 · 会议论文集论文</span></div><h2><a href="anomaly-detection.html">预测得准，为什么仍可能找错异常</a></h2><p>时间序列预测与异常检测有不同的目标。模型选择需要对齐最终任务，而不是只优化中间指标。</p></div><span class="note-time">3 分钟<i class="bi bi-arrow-up-right" aria-hidden="true"></i></span></article>
